selected_experts.reason: Verify the fish's identity as a tench (Tinca tinca) by checking for key taxonomic features: small deeply embedded cycloid scales, olive-green to golden-bronze coloration, small head with blunt downturned mouth, two short barbels at each corner, small eyes with reddish-orange iris, short rounded dorsal fin, truncate caudal fin, and complete lateral line.
Locate the tench in the image to enable precise boundary and feature analysis, particularly focusing on the fish's body, fins, barbels, and lateral line.
Check for boundary integrity of the fish, ensuring no floating parts, blurred edges, or fusion with the person's hands or the background. Verify the continuity of the fish's body and fins.
Audit the person holding the fish for anatomical correctness, ensuring complete limbs, valid joint structures, and no melting or distortion, especially in the hands holding the fish.

Verify the 3D structure of the scene, ensuring proper spatial separation between the person, the fish, the net, and the background vegetation. Check for perspective consistency and grounding of the person on the grass.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the tench's characteristic features: small embedded scales giving a smooth/slimy appearance, olive-green to golden-bronze coloration, small head with blunt downturned mouth, two short barbels at each corner, small eyes with reddish-orange iris, short rounded dorsal fin, truncate caudal fin, and complete lateral line. Ensure the person's hands holding the fish are anatomically correct and not fused with the fish. Verify the spatial relationship between the person, fish, net, and background vegetation.
